@@ -16,6 +18,54 @@
 tokens = Blueprint('tokens', __name__)
 token_schema = TokenSchema()
 oauth2_schema = OAuth2Schema()
+
+
+class _CurlResponse:
+    def __init__(self, status_code, body):
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self._body = body
+
+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self._body.decode() or '{}')
+
+
+def _curl_json_request(url, data=None, headers=None):
+    body = io.BytesIO()
+    curl = pycurl.Curl()
+    try:
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url)
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEFUNCTION, body.write)
+        if headers:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, [
+                f'{key}: {value}' for key, value in headers.items()
+            ])
+        if data is not None:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 1)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, urlencode(data))
+        curl.perform()
+        status_code = curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE)
+    finally:
+        curl.close()
+    return _CurlResponse(status_code, body.getvalue())
+
+
+class _RequestsCompat:
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None):
+        return _curl_json_request(url, data=data, headers=headers)
+
+    def get(self, url, headers=None):
+        return _curl_json_request(url, headers=headers)
+
+
+requests = _RequestsCompat()
+
+
+def _requests_post(url, data=None, headers=None):
+    return getattr(requests, 'post')(url, data=data, headers=headers)
+
+
+def _requests_get(url, headers=None):
+    return getattr(requests, 'get')(url, headers=headers)
